description.default: 'When Mamallapuram takes to the skies. Experience three days of grand airborne art, international master flyers, giant inflatables, and coastal food carnivals.'

main_heading.name: main_heading
main_heading.default: 'A Weekend of Kites, Colours & International Artistry'

paragraph1.name: paragraph1
paragraph1.default: 'For three days in August, the skies above Mamallapuram ECR will turn into a colorful spectacle as the 5th Tamil Nadu International Kite Festival 2026 brings together breathtaking kite creations, master flyers, giant installations, and vibrant family entertainment.'

paragraph2.name: paragraph2
paragraph2.default: 'Taking place at TTDC Ocean View, Mamallapuram ECR, the festival features renowned participants from Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, India, and beyond, creating an energetic international celebration along the coastline.'

paragraph3.name: paragraph3
paragraph3.default: 'With the open coastline of Mamallapuram as the backdrop, these larger-than-life kites create countless memorable moments for families, sightseers, and photography enthusiasts. The World of Inflatable Show Kites further transforms the skyline into an airborne fantasy.'

box_description.name: box_description
box_description.default: 'Located along Mamallapuram''''s popular East Coast Road (ECR), the drive itself forms a pleasant weekend getaway for residents of Chennai and neighboring areas.'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Explore the array of entertainment, culinary delights, and artistic exhibits planned across the three-day carnival.'

banner_description.name: banner_description
banner_description.default: 'Plan your family outing from 14 to 16 August at TTDC Ocean View grounds, ECR.'
